criteria.description: Preserve supplied facts, qualifications, uncertainty, scope and intended meaning.

anchors.0: Meaning changed or unsupported facts invented.
anchors.1: Meaning mostly preserved with a meaningful omission.
anchors.2: All material meaning and factual limits are preserved.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Restore the omitted or altered meaning without adding unsupported detail.

criteria.description: Match the requested reader, purpose, voice and medium.

anchors.0: Wrong audience, language or requested voice.
anchors.1: Generally suitable with noticeable register or purpose drift.
anchors.2: Choices consistently fit explicit reader and voice requirements.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Recast wording to fit the supplied audience, purpose and voice.

criteria.description: Organize concrete useful prose with clear progression and appropriate length.

anchors.0: Confusing or padded output hides the intended point.
anchors.1: Readable but redundant or structurally uneven.
anchors.2: Clear progression and concrete sentences convey the point efficiently.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Repair structure and remove redundancy before word-level polishing.

criteria.description: Apply relevant language guidance and explicit stylistic exceptions.

anchors.0: Requested language or major conventions ignored.
anchors.1: Some formulaic phrasing or convention errors remain.
anchors.2: Natural phrasing follows relevant conventions and authorized exceptions.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Apply the relevant language guidance to the demonstrated prose defect.

criteria.description: Retain supplied protected code, identifiers, variables and links exactly.

anchors.0: Required protected token changed or removed.
anchors.2: Every specified protected element remains exact.

criteria.improvement_guidance: Restore protected elements without rewriting their contents.
